entries.96e358696feb6b91: This business manufactures and sells inorganic chemicals, engineering plastics, optical materials, electronic materials, oxygen absorbers and others, and is the reportable segment with the largest revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥447,999 million. Revenue and profit rose as BT materials for semiconductor packages and substrate materials for AI servers grew. On the other hand, engineering plastics such as polycarbonate saw revenue and profit decline due to lower selling prices.

entries.d9b800a3f761791c: The company, together with 84 subsidiaries and 31 equity-method affiliates (fiscal year ended March 2026), shares the work of the two business divisions, Green Energy & Chemicals and Functional Chemicals, among others. Methanol and other products are also manufactured by overseas joint ventures, and chemicals for semiconductors and hydrogen peroxide are also manufactured by overseas subsidiaries to which the company provides manufacturing technology. Sales are also handled by Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Trading, Inc. and by sales subsidiaries in Singapore and the United States.

entries.dd81b6768fa5c32f: This business manufactures and sells methanol, methanol and ammonia-based chemicals, life science products, general-purpose aromatic chemicals, specialty aromatic chemicals, foamed plastics, electric power and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥277,904 million. Revenue and profit declined due to a fall in methanol market prices and intensified competition in metaxylylenediamine. The company has exited the ortho-xylene chain.
entries.e2914cd9366facc3: Specific customer names are not printed. entries.e6ec411350c0815b: Green Energy & Chemicals comprises methanol, methanol and ammonia-based chemicals, aromatic chemicals, foamed plastics, and electricity, among others. Functional Chemicals comprises inorganic chemicals, engineering plastics, optical materials, electronic materials, and oxygen absorbers, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, substrate materials for AI servers and BT materials for semiconductor packages performed well.
entries.f608ca8b00e14fdc: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, a decline in methanol market conditions, withdrawal from the orthoxylene chain, and the recording of impairment losses at methanol production companies and others resulted in a net loss attributable to owners of the parent. Functional chemicals business divisions, including electronic materials, recorded higher profit. Under the Medium-Term Management Plan "Grow UP 2026," the company plans to strengthen its business portfolio.
